min_stay.season: Memorial Day, Independence Day and Labor Day weekends (2027 rule)

values.note: Reserved site-specific on Kansas's ReserveAmerica site (campitks.gov). 2027 holiday minimum: 3 nights over Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day weekends (Friday-Sunday or Saturday-Monday). Up to 14 consecutive nights in one campground, then move to another campground in the park; a 14-day extension needs the park manager's written permission, and a five-day absence is required before camping again. Check-out 2 pm; call ahead if arriving after the office closes at 4 pm. Prairie Meadow 119-128 and Timber Road 401 are long-term sites.

note: KDWP park on the east shore of 4,500-acre Elk City Reservoir near Independence, in oak-hickory woods and prairie (RV Life mislabels it a city park). Four campgrounds along one park road: Sunset Point on the shore (sites 312-313 at the water's edge), Comfort Cove, Prairie Meadow (long pull-throughs on open grass) and Timber Road. Swim beach, boat ramps, trails. --Claude
